statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, 2≤x → (((block x).filter (fun n => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1)≠0 ∧ ¬ (n^2+1).Prime)).card : ℝ) ≤ C*(x : ℝ)^(2/3 : ℝ)*Real.log (2*(x : ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0066 · 以底数和指数计数二次序列上的真幂
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0066 · Count proper powers on the quadratic sequence by base and exponent

brief.zh: 每组 (p,k) 至多给出一个 n。底数至多为 O(x^{2/3})，指数至多为 O(log x)。
brief.en: Each pair (p,k) gives at most one n. Count bases up to O(x^{2/3}) and exponents up to O(log x).
